name: My Zypps Cryo Half Ounce - Candyland
description:
Infused and ready to roll. The My Zypps Candyland half ounce delivers 14 grams of pre-ground flower, cryo-infused for extra potency and full flavor — no grinder needed, just scoop and go.

Candyland brings a sweet, classic profile: sugary candy notes up front, layered with earthy spice and a smooth, subtly floral finish.

14G pre-ground cryo-infused flower — half ounce, ready to roll straight from the bag
Cryo-infused — extra potency with a smooth, even burn
Signature Candyland flavor — sugary sweetness with earthy spice

My Zypps Candyland is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
